summary: I have a rock everyone should mine stained in black graffiti of a gypsy invasion Still I sit and watch and think and sit, I return to my rock often, not every day but enough find your rock you need it #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I have a rock
everyone should

mine
stained in
black graffiti of
a gypsy invasion
Still I sit
and watch
and think and
sit,
I return to my rock
often, not every day but enough
find your rock
you need it
#smallpoems
